mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saju_input ( user_id, birth_date, gender, calendar_type, birth_time_type, birth_time_branch ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{calendarType}, #{birthTimeType}, #{birthTimeBranch} )
